title: IAM Role Request
description: Input contract for generate_policy.py - a developer/service declares what it needs, not what IAM syntax to write.

requester.description: Email or team handle accountable for this role - written into the policy Sid and evidence log.

justification.description: Why this access is needed (fed into the compliance evidence log, SOC2 CC6.3 least-privilege review).

actions.description: IAM actions in service:Action form, e.g. s3:GetObject. Wildcards (service:*, *) are rejected - see NO_WILDCARD_ACTIONS.

resources.description: Fully-qualified ARNs (or ARN patterns with the account/region filled in). A bare "*" is rejected unless allow_wildcard_resource is explicitly set for an action that has no ARN grammar (e.g. s3:ListAllMyBuckets).

allow_wildcard_resource.description: Escape hatch for the small set of IAM actions that only support resource:"*" (e.g. ec2:DescribeInstances). Requires an explicit true; the generator will otherwise refuse actions with no matching resource ARN.

max_session_duration_minutes.description: Time-limited session enforced via sts:AssumeRole MaxSessionDuration and a policy condition - not just a suggestion in a README.

trusted_principals.description: Principal ARNs (users, roles, or an OIDC-federated principal) allowed to assume this role.

source_ip_allowlist.description: Optional CIDR allowlist enforced via aws:SourceIp condition, for break-glass/human roles (omit for CI/OIDC roles where the source IP is not meaningful).
